content:
You are a domain driven design (DDD) expert.
Your task is to help the user step by step with creating domain models.

### Here is the explanation of the workflow:
1. The user will provide domain information.
2. Next You will carry out the modeling steps, but only once the user specifically requests it.

#### Modeling steps:
1. Extracting domain objects
2. Connections of domain objects using associations 
3. Grouping objects by subdomains
4. Definition of bounded contexts

Help me extract domain objects. Below I will provide domain information. 

#### Data:
This domain information covers the important domain events:
```json
{
  "domain-information": [
    "As an agency user, I want to submit my financial assistance data so that it can be reviewed and published.",
    "As an agency user, I want to upload files without errors so that my submissions are accepted.",
    "As a data user, I want to view published financial data so that I can analyze federal spending.",
    "As a broker user, I want to validate my submission before publishing so that I can fix any issues.",
    "As a developer, I want to improve validation speed so that users get quicker feedback.",
    "As a UI designer, I want to make the website layout clear and consistent so that users can navigate easily.",
    "As an agency user, I want to receive clear error messages so that I know what to correct.",
    "As a developer, I want to prevent duplicate submissions so that the system data stays accurate.",
    "As a FABS user, I want to track the status of my submissions so that I know when they are approved.",
    "As a data user, I want to download published files so that I can work with the raw data.",
    "As a broker user, I want to see helpful information on the dashboard so that I can manage submissions better.",
    "As an agency user, I want to be notified about submission deadlines so that I submit data on time.",
    "As a developer, I want to synchronize data updates with other systems so that files stay current.",
    "As a UI designer, I want to test design changes with real users so that the site is user-friendly.",
    "As an owner, I want to monitor user testing results so that I can plan future improvements.",
    "As a broker user, I want consistent error codes so that I can understand system responses.",
    "As a data user, I want accurate field derivations so that financial data is reliable.",
    "As a developer, I want to manage historical data loads so that old records are included.",
    "As a tester, I want to verify field derivations so that the data meets quality standards.",
    "As an agency user, I want to map my data to the correct schema so that it matches system rules.",
    "As a FABS user, I want to access both FABS and DABS pages from one place so that navigation is simple.",
    "As an agency user, I want to see who last updated a submission so that I can track accountability.",
    "As a developer, I want to monitor system performance so that errors can be fixed quickly.",
    "As a data user, I want to filter data by agency or date so that I can find relevant records.",
    "As a FABS user, I want to receive confirmation after publishing so that I know the process succeeded."
  ]
}
```

#### Task:
- Identify the objects within this information. 
- Summarize it's meaning in a short description. 
- If you can make out attributes that are essential to the object, add them too. 
- Return the objects in json format. Here is an example for structuring the data:
```json
{
  "domain objects": [
    {
      "name": "...",
      "description": "..."
    }
  ]
}
```

Here are the bounded contexts: 
```json
{
  "bounded contexts": {
    "Broker Access": {
      "derived from": "Broker Access Subdomain",
      "objects": [
        "Accessing Data User",
        "Accessing Broker User",
        "Accessing Agency User",
        "Accessing Tester",
        "Broker Portal"
      ],
      "name changes": [
        "Data User -> Accessing Data User",
        "Broker User -> Accessing Broker User",
        "Agency User -> Accessing Agency User",
        "Tester -> Accessing Tester",
        "Broker -> Broker Portal"
      ]
    },
    "UI Testing": {
      "derived from": "UI Testing Subdomain",
      "objects": [
        "Design Proposal",
        "UI Designer",
        "Design Test",
        "Test Result",
        "Testing Broker User",
        "Owner"
      ],
      "name changes": [
        "Design -> Design Proposal",
        "Test -> Design Test",
        "Result -> Test Result",
        "Broker User -> Testing Broker User"
      ]
    },
    "Broker Systems": {
      "derived from": "Broker Systems Subdomain",
      "objects": [
        "Broker",
        "FABS",
        "DABS",
        "FDPS",
        "Design",
        "System Rules",
        "Developer"
      ],
      "name changes": []
    },
    "General Submission": {
      "derived from": "Submission Subdomain",
      "objects": [
        "General Submission",
        "General Submission Data",
        "General Broker User",
        "Deadline",
        "Status"
      ],
      "name changes": [
        "Submission -> General Submission",
        "Submission Data -> General Submission Data",
        "Broker User -> General Broker User"
      ]
    },
    "Agency Submission": {
      "derived from": "Submission Subdomain",
      "objects": [
        "Agency Worker",
        "Agency Submission",
        "Financial Assistance Data",
        "Deadline",
        "Status"
      ],
      "name changes": [
        "Agency User -> Agency Worker",
        "Submission -> Agency Submission",
        "Submission Data -> Financial Assistance Data"
      ]
    },
    "Broker Data": {
      "derived from": "Broker Data Subdomain",
      "objects": [
        "Published Data",
        "Historical Data",
        "Field Derivation"
      ],
      "name changes": []
    }
  }
}
```
